doc_friction.issue: Two sessions opened 4 seconds apart were both sent to quick-pick-survey; claim_check made this one yield as designed, and the PR was retitled to chant-forge (cost one claim cycle).

Waiting on a long background command: a foreground `sleep` is blocked, and Monitor's schema must be loaded first; a foreground `timeout 590 bash -c 'until ...'` with a 600 s tool timeout was what worked.

Preflight and run_workflow_locally --for-changes together take over 10 minutes; the sweep's 300 s per-workflow budget leaves the site-builder test unrun, so the preflight is what actually verifies the site.

deviations.why: Allocator's row 6 (quick-pick-survey) was claimed by PR #15690 four seconds earlier; took the next row with no PR in 24 h (row 9, chant-forge) instead of the rows with fresh open PRs.
deviations.did: Retitled the claim PR to chant-forge and passed claim_check.

goal: Deepen a flagship with a measured, held-out improvement
notes: Looked at all 17 false quilisma calls by eye (5 porrectus stroke pieces, 7 stacked heads, 1 epiphonus head, 4 mottled squares). New rule isQuilisma in scan.mjs: a notched head is not a quilisma when its centre falls >=0.06 staff spaces left to right, a head is straight under it, or it has a liquescent tail. Chosen on 32 pieces (41 false calls to 16, no quilisma lost). Rule and the 18-piece held-out manifest (eval/quilisma-fresh-pages.json) committed in 550b5d86e before any of those pages was downloaded. Held out: other heads called quilismas 29 to 6 of 3,080; quilismas 47 of 55 under both versions (version 2 figures from the same checker with the new tests switched off via a temporary env flag, reverted). Same held-out pieces show 14 of 2,641 squares called rhombi (untouched rule), noted as next. Verification: node --test scan.test.mjs 13/13; run_venture_tests.py chant-forge ok; validate.py ok; venture-preflight chant-forge clean (second run; the first caught a 210-character post description, fixed); run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 8 of 9 workflows passed, portfolio-pages.yml site-builder test ran out of the 300 s sweep budget with no verdict (the preflight's site tests and build covered it), pages.yml no verdict after a skipped uses: step.
